domain_context: This scenario involves analyzing court cases and their details in order to establish citation relationships, propagate potential precedents, and identify relevant cases for new cases based on offense type, jurisdiction, and conviction outcomes.

predicate_verbalization.case: Case arg0 has name arg1, decision date arg2, jurisdiction arg3, parties arg4, offense arg5, punishment arg6, and decision arg7.
predicate_verbalization.casedet: Case details arg0 contain head matter arg1, corrections arg2, and opinions arg3.
predicate_verbalization.newcase: New case arg0 has name arg1 and offense arg2.
predicate_verbalization.t: Case arg0 with name arg1 is linked to head matter arg2 and opinions arg3.
predicate_verbalization.shouldCite: Case arg0 should cite case arg1.
predicate_verbalization.mayCite: New case arg0 with name arg1 may cite case arg2.
predicate_verbalization.relevantCase: New case arg0 with name arg1 has relevant precedent case arg2 with name arg3.

rule_verbalization.1: If case arg0 has name arg1, and case details arg2 contain head matter arg3 and opinions arg4, and arg3 = arg1, then case arg0 with name arg1 is linked to head matter arg3 and opinions arg4.
rule_verbalization.2: If case arg0 with name arg1 is linked to head matter arg2 and opinions arg3, and case arg4 with name arg5 is linked to head matter arg1 and opinions arg6, then case arg4 cites case arg0.
rule_verbalization.3: If case arg0 cites case arg1, then case arg0 should cite case arg1.
rule_verbalization.4: If case arg0 should cite case arg1, and case arg1 cites case arg2, then case arg0 should cite case arg2.
rule_verbalization.5: If new case arg0 has name arg1 and offense arg2, and case arg3 has offense arg4, and arg2 = arg4, then new case arg0 with name arg1 may cite case arg3.
rule_verbalization.6: If new case arg0 with name arg1 may cite case arg2, and case arg2 should cite case arg3, then new case arg0 with name arg1 may cite case arg3.
rule_verbalization.Q: If new case arg0 with name arg1 may cite case arg2, and case arg2 has name arg3 and decision 'convicted', then new case arg0 with name arg1 has relevant precedent case arg2 with name arg3.
